cards.title: Doubles and near doubles: quick review
cards.body: Double a number by doubling its tens and its ones: double $34$ is $68$. For a near double like $6 + 7$, double the smaller number and add one.

cards.title: Halves and double-halve: quick review
cards.body: Halve the tens and the ones: half of $68$ is $34$. To multiply, you can double one number and halve the other: $5 \times 14 = 10 \times 7$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.
